senses.gloss: ऋत्व्-अन्त m. the close of a season, Mn. iv, 26
the termination of menstruation, W.
ऋत्व्-अन्त mfn. forming the close of a season (as a day), Mn. iv, 119.
ऋत्व्-इक् (in comp. for ऋत्वि॑ज् below)
ऋत्व्-इक्—त्व n. the state of being a Ṛtvij or priest, TāṇḍyaBr.
ऋत्व्-इक्—पथ m. the path of the priest on the sacrificial ground, Lāṭy.
ऋत्व्-इक्—फल n. the reward of a priest, Jaim.
ऋत्विग्-आशिस् f. a wish or prayer uttered by the officiating priest, ŚrS.
ऋत्व्-इ॑ज् mfn. (fr. √ यज्), sacrificing at the proper time, sacrificing regularly

ऋत्व्-इ॑ज् (क्), m. a priest (usually four are enumerated, viz. Hotṛ, Adhvaryu, Brahman, and Udgātṛ; each of them has three companions or helpers, so that the total number is sixteen, viz. होतृ, Maitrāvaruṇa, Acchāvāka, Grāva-stut; अध्वर्यु, Prati-prasthātṛ, Neṣṭṛ, Un-netṛ; ब्रह्मन्, Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, Agnīdhra, Potṛ; उद्गातृ, Prastotṛ, Pratihartṛ, Subrahmaṇya, ĀśvŚr. iv, 1, 4-6), RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c.
ऋत्व्-इज् See p. 224, col. 2.
ऋत्व n. (fr. ऋतु॑), timely or matured semen, TāṇḍyaBr. x, 3, 1
proper time, time fit for generation, Āp. ii, 5, 17.
ऋत्वन् m. N. of a Gandharva, MBh.
ऋत्वि॑य mfn. (fr. ऋतु॑), being in proper time, observing or keeping the proper time, regular, proper, RV.; AV. iii, 20, 1; vii, 72, 1; VS.
ऋ॑त्विय (ऋ॑त्विय), n. the time after the courses (favourable for procreation), AV. xii, 3, 29; TS. ii, 5, 1, 5.
ऋत्विय &c. See ib.
ऋत्वि॑या f. (voc. ऋ॑त्विये) a woman in or after her courses, a woman during the time favourable for procreation, AV. xiv, 2, 37
ऋत्विय—वत् mfn. having courses, being at the period fit for generation, TBr. i.
ऋत्वि॑या-वत् mfn. in proper time, regular, proper, RV.
ऋ॑त्व्य mfn. belonging to the time fit for generation, RV. x, 183, 2.
